summary: Creates embossed relief by comparing neighboring pixels from a selected source channel.

key_params.name: select
key_params.note: Source channel: luminance, RGBA channels, RGB average, or RGBA average

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Neighbor comparison: prevcur, curnext, or prevnext

common_gotchas: Low-contrast source images may produce weak relief.
Direction changes the perceived lighting and can invert the raised/depressed look.
Midpoint shifts the neutral balance between shadows and highlights.
Offset changes relief scale and is resolution-sensitive in pixel units.
key_concepts: Emboss TOP creates raised or recessed relief from image edge differences.
Select chooses the source channel or channel average used to derive relief.
Method controls which neighboring samples are compared.
Midpoint sets the neutral gray around which highlights and shadows form.
Strength controls relief depth, and Direction controls perceived light direction.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
